description: This file defines the PasswordEnforceException class within the OrangeHRM authentication module. The class is a specialized exception that handles password enforcement logic, including generating a reset code and providing a redirect URL for password changes.

classes.name: PasswordEnforceException
classes.description: A custom exception class that enforces password policies and provides mechanisms to generate a reset code and redirect URL after a password enforcement event.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the exception with a name and message.

methods.name: generateResetCode
methods.description: Generates a password enforcement reset code by logging the request via the password strength service.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL to redirect the user to for changing their weak password, including the reset code.
